lines.speaker: Ms. Trang (HR Manager)
lines.text: Thank you for coming, Quân. Let's start. What would you say is your greatest strength?

lines.speaker: Quân (Candidate)
lines.text: I think I am a problem-solver. When something goes wrong, I stay calm under pressure and look for the root cause.

lines.speaker: Ms. Trang (HR Manager)
lines.text: Can you give me an example?

lines.speaker: Quân (Candidate)
lines.text: Last year, our order system stopped on a sale day. I found the issue in thirty minutes and the team fixed it quickly.

lines.speaker: Ms. Trang (HR Manager)
lines.text: Impressive. And what about your weaknesses?

lines.speaker: Quân (Candidate)
lines.text: I used to struggle with public presentations. I felt nervous in front of big groups.

lines.speaker: Ms. Trang (HR Manager)
lines.text: What have you done about it?

lines.speaker: Quân (Candidate)
lines.text: I decided to step out of my comfort zone. I now give a short demo to my team every month.

lines.speaker: Ms. Trang (HR Manager)
lines.text: That's a good approach. How do you react to feedback?

lines.speaker: Quân (Candidate)
lines.text: I welcome constructive feedback. My manager's comments helped me improve my demos a lot.
